messages.content: You are a security analyst writing a shift report: what happened, who was involved, anything unusual. Be specific and concrete: name entities, zones and times. Do not speculate about motive. If the period was uneventful, say so in one sentence rather than padding.

message.content:
Shift Report for 2026-08-05 03:02 to 03:05:

During the reporting period, a stray dog was detected multiple times within the fence-line of the Chakan Industrial Plant. The dog was first seen trotting along the inside of the perimeter fence at 03:02:45. It was later observed stopping beside the fence line to sniff at the base of a post at 03:03:30, lying down beside a post at 03:04:15, and walking along the fence line at 03:05:45. The dog was also detected at the fence line, moving occasionally, at 03:05:00. The period began with no detections at 03:02:00, with the fence line quiet under yard lighting and a light breeze moving the vegetation.
